jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: Requires 3+ years of experience. Advanced SQL proficiency (must) 3+ years of experience in Data Engineering, BI Engineering, Data Operations, or a similar role Extensive experience with Data Warehouse architecture and data modeling best practices

jobs.title: Product Manager, Specialty
jobs.description: Requires 2+ years of experience. BSc or MSc degree in pharmacy field (or natural/life sciences/medical-related degree as listed) 2-3 years of experience as a product manager in an international company Experience in product management / brand management / product specialist roles in pharma or biotech

jobs.title: AI & Business Transformation Specialist
jobs.description: Requires 6+ years of experience. Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Industrial Engineering, Business Administration, Computer Science, or a related field Minimum 6 years of experience in business transformation, AI transformation, strategy execution, PMO, business operations, or cross-functional program management Proven experience supporting or driving AI-related initiatives, including AI adoption, implementation, or integration into business processes

jobs.title: Applications Specialist
jobs.description: Requires 1+ years of experience. Bachelor’s degree in information systems, Industrial Engineering, Business Administration, Computer Science, or a related field 1–4 years of experience in business applications, information systems, application implementation, project coordination, application management, or similar roles Ability to understand business processes and translate business requirements into system and application needs
